task.title: Set up and start the pressure washer
task.shortdesc: Connect the water supply and hoses, purge air from the system, and start the .

ul.li: A garden hose no longer than 50 ft (15 m) and a water supply of at least 1.5 gal/min (5.7 L/min)3.0 gal/min (11.4 L/min)
A grounded 120 V outlet on a 15 A circuit
Fresh unleaded gasoline, 87 octane or higher, with no more than 10% ethanol
The personal protective equipment listed in

context.p: Place the machine on a level surface outdoors, where spray and runoff cannot reach electrical outlets or open drains.

step.cmd: Check that the inlet screen is clean and seated in the garden hose inlet.

info.p: Rinse the screen under running water if you see debris.
Remove the dipstick, wipe it, and reinsert it without screwing it in. The oil should reach the upper mark. The engine ships with oil, but the level can drop in transit.

step.cmd: Fill the fuel tank to the bottom of the filler neck.
Connect the garden hose to the garden hose inlet and tighten it by hand.
Connect the high-pressure hose to the pump outlet and to the spray gun.

info.p: Pull back on each quick-connect fitting to confirm it is locked.

step.cmd: Insert a nozzle into the end of the spray wand.

info.p: For a first test, use the white 40° nozzle. See .

step.cmd: Turn on the water supply fully. Release the trigger lock, point the spray gun at the ground, and squeeze the trigger until a steady stream of water flows with no air sputtering.

stepresult.p: Air is purged from the pump and hoses.

step.cmd: Plug the power cord into the outlet and press TEST and then RESET on the GFCI device.

stepresult.p: The GFCI indicator light turns on.

step.cmd: Turn the power switch to ON.

substep.cmd: Turn the fuel valve to ON.
If the engine is cold, move the choke lever to CHOKE.
Move the engine switch to ON.

step.cmd: Squeeze the trigger and hold it, then pull the starter cord slowly until you feel resistance, and pull it quickly.

info.p: Holding the trigger releases pressure in the pump so the engine is easier to start.

step.cmd: After the engine warms up, slowly move the choke lever to RUN.
Hold the spray gun with both hands and squeeze the trigger to begin cleaning.

info.p: Start with the nozzle at least 24 in. (60 cm) from the surface and move closer slowly. Engage the trigger lock whenever you pause.

result.p: The pressure washer is running and ready for use. When you finish, follow .
